data.tax_note: Unterhaltsvorschuss payments are a tax-free state benefit for the child and are not normally reported on the parent's tax return.
data.explanation: The Jugendamt (youth welfare office) of Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück has decided to pay you €293 per month, starting 1 November 2026, as advance maintenance (Unterhaltsvorschuss) for your daughter Marie, since the office is now pursuing the father's maintenance claim itself. You must immediately tell the office if the father pays maintenance directly or if you move. If you disagree with the amount or the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person; the app will show you the exact deadline. Letters sent by post from this office are legally considered received on the 4th day after posting, which is why the objection period is counted that way.
data.title: Unterhaltsvorschuss decision for daughter Marie – €293/month from 1 November 2026
data.summary: The Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück Jugendamt (Unterhaltsvorschusskasse) notifies Annika Beispielsteiner that, starting 1 November 2026, it will pay €293 per month as advance child maintenance (Unterhaltsvorschuss) for her daughter Marie, while the office itself pursues the claim against the father.
